events.description: At the beginning, the Original Creator created the universe and was the incarnation of all things.
On the first day, the Original Creator awoke and created this world.
On the second day, the Oldest One birthed the Mother Goddess of Depravity, the Mother Tree of Desire, and the Son of Chaos.
On the third day, the Oldest One and the Mother Goddess united, and the Mother of All Things gave birth to a firstborn daughter, the Goddess of Fate.
After the Goddess of Fate, the other Outer Deities were born one after another from the union between the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity.
The Circle of Inevitability was 'Their' eldest son.
The Original Creator entered deep slumber underground.

In 'His' sleep, the Original Creator split into multiple personas. 'They' were also in a state of slumber, but 'They' began to use the authority and Beyonder Characteristics 'They' controlled to influence the world, making many preparations for when the true awakening and dissociation occured. The Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings were the most powerful and active ones among all personas.
Many folklores and legends in this time were based on actual mysterious events.
Human Civilization reached at least 21st century of the modern period under the Gregorian calendar.
The research institute in Chernobyl discovered something deep inside the field, and people started to turn into crude oil. The research facility has been sealed from the outside.

events.note: Roselle mentioned several contemporary media — Lin Gao’s Five Hundred Good-for-nothings (临高启明), Tik Tok, Kings of Glory and PUBG — that he had engaged with before his transmigration.
events.description: The Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings made certain preparations by secretly seizing the Spirit Bodies of people through various means and hung them in the transparent cocoons in the Sefirah Castle as 'His' candidates.
Huang Tao bought a mysterious silver plate with some strange symbols and patterns engraved on it.
Zhou Mingrui discovered an old book and performed the Luck Enhancement Ritual.

First Epoch.name: First Epoch: The Age of Chaos

events.description: The Original Creator awakened, leading to the destruction of most of humanity and the onset of apocalypse. 'His' kin emerged from oil wells, volcanic depths, and oceanic trenches. 'He' completely split into six Sefirot, sixteen Uniquenesses, and countless Beyonder Characteristics. 'His' awakening caused a convergence force that split off parts of the Sefirot, Uniquenesses, and Beyonder Characteristics from 'His' three direct children and attracted them to Earth: the Mother Goddess of Depravity, the Son of Chaos, and the Mother Tree of Desire. When the total number of twenty-two pathways and the nine sefirot was reached, everything finally reached a balance. The previous Seven Lights were wiped out.

The residual power of the Original Creator constitutes the Astral Barrier around Earth. Many Outer Deities came to Earth to either retrieve the Sefirot, Uniquenesses and characteristics originally belonging to 'Them', or to obtain additional Sefirot, Uniquenesses and characteristics neighboring 'Them' to become stronger. However, 'They' were blocked by the Astral Barrier, and have stayed in the Solar System ever since.

Earth had great reconstructions through time. North America became the Northern Continent. South America became the Southern Continent. A large part of the isthmus that connects the two landmasses has been wiped away by some kind of power, forming the Berserk Sea. Midseashire is the expanded and connected version of the Great Lakes of North America, likely as a result of a strike from a massive meteor. Greenland became the Sonia Island. East Asia became the Western Continent. Europe and West Asia became the Eastern Continent, later known as the Forsaken Land of the Gods. Australia fell and became the Abyss.

The various Beyonder Characteristics were subsequently acquired by humans, animals, and surviving creatures, resulting in various mutations such as giants, elves, demons, dragons, feathered serpents, orcs, naga, sea monsters, and wraiths.

The Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings leveraged 'Their' long-prepared ancient schemes across the times of the Old Earth to gradually gain advantages in 'Their' fight against the other Sefirot. 'They' eventually defeated the other Sefirot (excluding the Brood Hive and the Key of Light) and shattered 'Their' wills, making those wills take a very long time to recover and awaken again. The Son of Chaos bypassed the Astral Barrier by killing 'Himself' and then resurrecting through the Black Emperor ability. 'He' encountered the Celestial Worthy and was controlled by 'Him'. 'His' remaining part in the Cosmos was the Uncertain Mist.

The Celestial Worthy and the Primordial God Almighty absorbed additional Sefirot, which increased 'Their' instinct for convergence until 'They' could no longer control 'Themselves', and 'They' began taking actions against each other. The Celestial Worthy accommodated the Nation of Disorder and the River of Eternal Darkness. The Primordial God Almighty accommodated the City of Calamity and the Tenebrous World. The Primordial God Almighty and Celestial Worthy's strength deterred the Outer Deities, who could only settle for observing Earth from afar. During this era, the Primordial God Almighty served as the sun.

The Primordial God Almighty and the Brood Hive gave birth to Omebella and Zedus, making certain arrangements. The Son of Chaos was sealed inside the Magic Wishing Lamp by the Celestial Worthy, and became the Genie.

The Celestial Worthy and the Primordial God Almighty engaged in full-scale war, extinguishing the 'sun' and plunging the world into darkness. In the end, both perished. The First Blasphemy Slate was born from the remains of the Primordial God Almighty in the Chaos Sea, and beside it was the Uniqueness of the Error Pathway. The Sefirot other than the Chaos Sea and the Sefirah Castle were sealed in the Western Continent by the Celestial Worthy. Before the seal, the Elves left the Western Continent and were never able to return.

The Beyonder races, once suppressed by the two Pillars, lost their restraints. Driven by madness and the instinct to converge, they fought against the kins of chaos and each other, staining the land and seas with blood. Omebella was driven by maternal instinct to end the chaos. Zedus sought only the body bearing the Moon Uniqueness, aiming to ascend through the blessings the Brood Hive granted across the barrier.

Omebella discovered Aurmir, and helped him regain some rationality. Zedus' death and the birth of Aurmir, the first Ancient God, marked the end of the First Epoch—the rise of a true deity not born of the Original Creator. The barrier's countdown began.
The new Seven Lights was born from the Spirit World.
Edefana was born. 'He' was corrupted by the Primordial God Almighty.

The Eldritch Kin of Chaos (of The Original Creator) gradually dwindled and eliminated. A mythical era of rivalry among King of Giants, King of Elves, King of Mutants, Dragon, Phoenix, Demonic Wolf, Races of the Sea, and Demons began. At this time, except for mutants and werewolves who were divided, the giants, elves, vampires, and humans are still coexisting as a single unified 'human' race (or race of humanoids), they have yet to split. First-generation of Ancient Gods appeared one after another. The sky, the land, the sea, and the underground world slowly changed from disorderliness to orderliness. After the supernatural races obtained a certain level of intelligence and had their own languages, creatures finally had some knowledge of history. The first language, Elvish, was created by the first-generation Elf King.
Due to the purification of Beyonder Characteristics, the major races have evolved their own characters and civilizations, and eight Ancient Gods have emerged one after another.

events.date: Start less than 1,000 years before the end of the Early Era of Fire
events.description: The world was ruled by eight Ancient Gods, 'They' ruled sky, land, and oceans. 'They' ruled over the Spirit World and Astral World, and various races. 'They' fought against each other in different camps, quasi-humans fought non-humans, devils, and demonic wolves.
Amanises transmigrated. 'She' was the Goddess of Misfortune, one of the Subsidiary Gods of the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea.

Humans were subordinates or even slaves of Giants, Elves, and Sanguines. Giant King Aurmir buried 'His' parents inside the Waning Forest of the Giant King's Court. The Kingdom of Silver was ruled by the Giant King's Court and later came under its jurisdiction. They believed in Omebella.
The Ancient Sun God walked out the Chernobyl. 'He' gained the First Blasphemy Slate, the control over the Chaos Sea, and the Uniqueness of the Error Pathway.

Not long after 'He' walked out of Chernobyl, 'He' created Sasrir with part of 'His' personality, Authority of Degeneration and Characteristics of Hanged Man Pathway. Sasrir became the first King of Angels of the Ancient Sun God.

events.date: 800-900 years before the end of the Second Epoch.
events.description: Giant King Aurmir betrayed Sanguine Ancestor Lilith and caused 'Her' to perish. Mutated King Kvastir and Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea also died with 'Her'. 'Their' Subsidiary Gods were either killed, turned to other Gods, or vanished and hid in the dark. Lilith's Goddess of Life and Kvastir's God of War were killed. No one remembers 'Their' names. Flegrea's God of the Dead turned to Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace. Kvastir's God of Spiritual Creatures and Flegrea's Goddess of Misfortune vanished. Lilith's Goddess of Beauty turned to Elf King Soniathrym. After Lilith perished, Elf King Soniathrym went to Giant King's Court to confront the Giant King.

The war continued for several hundred years. During this time, giants and dragons were the dominant race. When a new balance between the five races was formed, the world had recovered some level of peace. The giants, elves, dragons, devils, and phoenixes coexisted, splitting up their rule over lands and seas. Vampires, demonic wolves, treants, sea monsters, mutants, and humans were vassals of the different factions, occupying the lower-middle classes.
The new generation of supernatural races gradually gained some level of rationality. Groselle and Siatas were born.

The Ancient Gods had attempted to resolve the pollution of the Chaos Sea completely. Later, 'They' gave up on the idea of directly exerting influence, and 'They' switched focus to sealing and guarding it. Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt sealed the pollution of the Chaos Sea in Groselle's Travels, and 'He' hid the City of Miracle Liveseyd inside the subconsciousness of the book.

The River of Eternal Darkness was the first Sefirah to seep out energy from the sealed Western Continent and formed a distributary through Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace to the outside world. Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace created the Underworld that exists in the Spirit World. 'She' transferred Calderón City and hid the clues about the River of Eternal Darkness inside.
Groselle entered Groselle's Travels.

Giant King Aurmir wanted to work with some secret sects that have sprouted from the humans to deal with Elf King Soniathrym. This matter was led by Goddess of Harvest Omebella and God of Dawn Badheil.
Siatas entered Groselle's Travels.
The Evernight Goddess' followers formed a secret organization. The Revelation of Evernight indicates that the church is nearly 3000 years old, but there are mythical legends before that.

Ancient Sun God fought against the ancient gods and took 'Their' powers. Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt, Elf King Soniathrym, Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace, Giant King Aurmir perished because of 'Him'. Devil Monarch Farbauti escaped to the Abyss and hid there ever since. 'He' goes by the name 'Dark Side of the Universe' in the Fifth Epoch. After the Second Epoch, the Abyss had never revealed itself to the world again. After an unknown period of time, before Roselle's era in the Fifth epoch, it had changed and it was no longer suitable for devils to survive.

Omebella fell at the end of the Second Epoch. 'Her' corpse became a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact Gift of the Land, which is owned by the current City of Silver. Lilith pretended to be Omebella from this point forward with the help of the Ancient Sun God and the Evernight Goddess. Queen of Calamity Cohinem split 'Her' Beyonder characteristics and was in an unstable state. Dragon of Wisdom turned to the Ancient Sun God and became the Wisdom Angel, one of 'His' Kings of Angels.

Ancient Sun God gradually promoted to the level of quasi-God Almighty and claimed 'Himself' the Original Creator, the Omnipotent and omniscient God, the Lord that created everything. The Primordial God Almighty's consciousness was awakening inside the Ancient Sun God's body. In order to reduce the madness originating from the corruption, 'He' had deliberately used the method of having children.

Ancient Sun God separated 'His' Uniqueness and Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics of the Visionary Pathway and created Adam. Beyond reducing corruption, this also hid 'His' resurrection method. The Kingdom of Silver convert their faith from Omebella to the Omnipotent and omniscient God, the Lord that created everything.

The Quill of Alzuhod appeared at the end of the Second Epoch. This Sealed Artifact originated from the Dragon of Nightmare Alzuhod, the son of the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt. At an unknown point in time, it fell into the hands of the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
The Evernight Goddess became Sequence 0 some time at the end of the Second Epoch.

After the death of 'Their' father, the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea, Antigonus and the Mother of the Sky crossed the sea and came to the Northern Continent. 'They' set up a hidden country, the Nation of the Evernight and the City of the Dead in the uninhabited Hornacis Mountain Range.
Hermes Language was created based on Jotun and Dragonese by Hermes.

Red Angel Medici gave Moon City a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, which corresponds to sequence 4 Iron-blooded Knight of Red Priest Pathway. After the vampire civilization was destroyed, Moon City followed the Ancient Sun God. The Ancient Sun God ordered the residents of the Moon City to guard the barrier fog that sealed the Western Continent.
The rise of the Ancient Sun God established a new era belonging to mankind - the Third Epoch.
Amon was born from the Uniqueness of the Error Pathway from the Ancient Sun God, and a Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristic.

After the death of all Ancient Gods, Humans walked out of the shadow of other races and became the dominant race of the land. The Ancient Sun God became the absolute ruler of the world and the one and only Orthodox God. There were 8 Kings of Angels under 'Him': Dark Angel Sasrir, Angel of Imagination Adam, Angel of Time Amon, Wisdom Angel Herabergen, Wind Angel Leodero, White Angel Aucuses, Angel of Fate Ouroboros, War Angel Medici.
God of Glory Bladel publicly cursed the Ancient Sun God. 'He' was punished to forever wandered around Chernobyl.
Snowman was born around this time before he entered Groselle's Travels.
Some of the Evernight Goddess' believers hid within the church of the Ancient Sun God.
The Earth Mother and the God of Combat became Sequence 0 around this time.
Rose Redemption was founded under the tacit agreement of the Ancient Sun God. 'They' often schemed in the Giant King's Court.
Sasrir fell asleep inside the Giant King's Court. Murskogan originally served Giant King Aurmir, he later converted to Sasrir and guarded the giant door where Sasrir slept inside.
Ancient Sun God was besieged by Rose Redemption and died at the place now known as the Sea of Ruins.
Wisdom Angel, White Angel, and Wind Angel betrayed the Ancient Sun God and shared 'His' Beyonder Characteristics to become Sequence 0 of 'Their' pathways.
Bladel died during the Cataclysm, but 'He' still wasn’t able to free 'Himself' from the Ancient Sun God's punishment. 'His' corpse was reanimated and continued to wander around Chernobyl.

After the Ancient Sun God's death, the Eastern Continent where the Kingdom of Silver and Moon City were located was isolated from the rest of the world, and became known as the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'.

Fourth Epoch.name: Fourth Epoch: The Epoch of The Gods

events.description: The death of the Ancient Sun God. The birth of the True Creator. The remnant consciousness of the Ancient Sun God was only able to obtain the Hanged Man's Uniqueness and characteristics from 'His' dead corpse to create the True Creator.

The Second Blasphemy Slate was born after the fall of the Ancient Sun God. Bethel Abraham, Solomon, Zaratul, Alista Tudor, Trunsoest, Augustus, Einhorn, Sauron, Castiya, Zoroast, Stiano, Constantine, Cheek, and the Artisan saw the complete Second Blasphemy Slate, before Adam took the Slate away. Sealed Artifact 0-13 The Last Banquet originated from the Ancient Sun God, and fell into the hands of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun. The Unshadowed Crucifix fell into the hands of Adam.
Beastmen and Treants went extinct after the Cataclysm. This is an era full of conflicts and wars.
In the Forsaken Land of the Gods, the Kingdom of Silver was gradually destroyed by the Things of the Dark, until they were in a city-state and called themselves the 'City of Silver'.

In this era, Gods walked the land and frequently performed miracles. 'They' established 'Their' so-called Orthodox Churches. Church of the Evernight Goddess, Church of the God of Combat, Church of the Earth Mother, Church of the Lord of Storms, Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
The first angel of the Zoroast Family perished. With the help of Solomon, the Zoroast family didn't lose the Beyonder Characteristics.
Salinger became Sequence 0 of the Death Pathway around this time.

Solomon became a Sequence 0 of the Black Emperor Pathway. 'He' established the Solomon Empire, and ruled over the Northern Continent. 'He' was supported by multiple Angel Families and the True Creator.

Antigonus advanced to Attendant of Mysteries, 'He' left the Hornacis Mountain Range and returned to the real world outside the Nation of the Evernight. 'He' was one of the supporters of the Solomon Empire. The Gods were hostile to each other. Thus 'They' couldn't form an alliance to fight the Black Emperor and the True Creator. The Evernight Goddess, the God of Combat and Death were confronting each other. The Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom had great disputes. The Earth Mother's attitude was ambiguous, though 'She' was slightly leaned towards the God of Combat.
Death united the Southern Continent and established the Balam Empire, 'He' called 'Himself' the 'Underworld Emperor'.
Mobet Zoroast was born around this time. He was later sucked into the Groselle's Travels after a large-scale war.
Alista Tudor and Trunsoest rebelled against Solomon and the Solomon Empire with the support of the Six Orthodox Gods. Solomon and Solomon Empire perished.

Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire was established. Its double consul ruled over the Northern Continent. Angel Families mostly turned to support 'Them', except Zaratul and Zoroast Family which still faithfully believed in the Black Emperor. Tudor Empire: Tudor Family, Abraham Family, Antigonus Family, Amon Family, Jacob Family, Tamara Family. Trunsoest Empire: Trunsoest Family, Augustus Family, Castiya Family, Einhorn Family, Sauron Family, Sanguines.
The Primordial Demoness became Sequence 0 around this time and formed the Demoness family.

Antigonus managed to accommodate the Uniqueness of the Fool Pathway with the help of Adam and Amon. 'He' became the Half-Fool. During that time, Alista Tudor secretly built the mausoleums as part of the apotheosis ritual to become Sequence 0: Black Emperor, with Bethel Abraham's assistance. However, 'His' plan failed due to the resurrection of Solomon.
Azik Eggers was born. Later 'He' became the Death Consul of the Balam Empire.
The six gods supported Trunsoest to promote to Sequence 0 of the Justiciar Pathway. Trunsoest gained the support of the Sanguines through 'His' marriage with the Blood Moon Queen Auernia.

With the aid from Adam and Amon, Alista Tudor entrapped and killed all 3 Sequence 1 Angels of the Red Priest Pathway. Medici, Sauron, and Einhorn died. The Sauron-Einhorn-Medici evil spirit was born. Alista Tudor switched 'His' pathway and became a Sequence 0 of the Red Priest Pathway, but went mad as the cost of switching to a non-neighboring pathway. Black Emperor Solomon managed to resurrect and rebuild the Second Solomon Empire. Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire broke apart.

events.date: Start in year 1,047, 537 years after Alista became the Red Priest.
events.description: The Four Emperors, who were all Sequence 0, fought against each other along with 'Their' subordinate Angel Families.

Blood Moon Queen Auernia died. The Sanguines suffered a terrible blow and had no choice but to retreat to an uninhabited mountain to hide in the shadows. Black Emperor Solomon, Blood Emperor Tudor and Night Emperor Trunsoest perished in the war. Sealed Artifact 0-02 Trunsoest Brass Book originates from Trunsoest's Justiciar Uniqueness that had been corrupted by the Sefirah Nation of Disorder. It fell into the hands of the Church of the God of Combat.

After the fall of the Blood Emperor, Angel Families under the Tudor Empire declined. The ancestor of the Zaratul Family was killed by the Half-Fool Antigonus and Bethel Abraham. Bethel Abraham was banished by the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms. The remaining High-Sequence Beyonders in the family all perished. Evernight Goddess sealed Antigonus in the Foggy Town after 'He' lost control and went mad. The Church of the Evernight Goddess eliminated the Antigonus Family and the Nation of the Evernight. Mother of the Sky was turned into Sealed Artifact 0-17, a vessel for Evernight Goddess' descent. The Underworld Emperor was said to benefit the most from the war, gaining the Uniqueness of Red Priest Pathway.

At some point in time, Amon secretly killed the ancestor of the Jacob Family and obtained 'His' Sequence 1 characteristic. 'He' then pretended to be Jacob in the later years of the Fourth Epoch. Sealed Artifact 0-32 Theater With Curtains That Never Draw was a product of this era. It later fell into the hands of the Church of the Lord of Storms.

The God of Craftsmanship became Sequence 0 during the late stage of this epoch, sometime after the War of the Four Emperors and before the Pale Disaster. God of Craftsmanship did not digest the sequence 1 potion well before promoting to sequence 0 for various reasons. Thus 'He' was also the weakest God of the seven Orthodox Gods. 'His' birth is related to the Moses Ascetic Order. The revival of the Hidden Sage is related to the relationship between the Moses Ascetic Order and the God of Craftsmanship of the Fourth Epoch.

The High Priest of the Moon City designed the honorific name, prayer stanza, and the corresponding symbols for The Eternally Imperturbable Fog, the barrier fog that sealed the Western Continent, and he vaguely heard a series of voices coming from deep within the fog.

This era lasted until Death perished in the early Fifth Epoch. In the Northern Continent, only the Trunsoest Empire survived and was split by the four noble families. 'They' established the Four Great Nations of the Northern Continent, under the support of different Orthodox Gods. Augustus: Loen Kingdom (Lord of Storms, Evernight Goddess, God of Craftsmanship). Castiya: Feynapotter Kingdom (Earth Mother, God of Knowledge and Wisdom). Einhorn: Feysac Kingdom (God of Combat). Sauron: Intis Kingdom (Eternal Blazing Sun, God of Craftsmanship).
Abraham Family gradually declined because of the curse on Blood Moon night. Sanguines retreated to an uninhabited mountain to hide in the shadows so as to maintain the continuation of the race.

events.time: Over 100 years after the War of the Four Emperors ended, the Pale Disaster began
events.description: Death left a piece of 'His' soul in Azik Eggers in order to resurrect in the future. Death went mad from attempting to accommodate the Uniqueness of Red Priest Pathway with the help of the River of Eternal Darkness. After over a century of 'digestion'. 'He' wasn’t able to resist the desire for converging the Twilight Giant and Darkness pathways, 'He' joined forces with the Primordial Demoness to wreak havoc and create a Pale Disaster on the Northern Continent.

Apart from the three great empires and the true deities and Kings of Angels behind them, the Fourth Epoch also had the influence of the Demoness Sect and the Moses Ascetic Order. There was also the Abyss’ infiltration and secretly developed Artisans, as well as the Southern Continent’s Balam.

In addition, there were many crucial factors at stake. With the fading will of the Original Creator: The Barrier was weakening. Along with the death of the Ancient Sun God, the invasion of reality by the Outer Deities clearly deepened. The seal on the Western Continent by the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings was gradually weakening. The Sefirot instinctively (or consciously) used 'Their' symbolism to corrode 'Their' respective Uniqueness and High-Sequence Beyonder characteristics in an attempt to influence the outside world. In the Fourth Epoch, traces of more Sefirot began to appear on the Northern and Southern Continents and the islands over the Five Seas. The City of Calamity secretly seeped out energy from sealed Western Continent, affecting the cities behind the door of Binsy Town. The Nation of Disorder corrupted the Justiciar Uniqueness and turned it into the Trunsoest Brass Book.
At the end of the Fourth Epoch, cracks appeared on the Barrier. The Seven Orthodox Gods had to move 'Their' divine kingdoms to the Astral World to fill in the gap.

Death Consul Azik fought the Saints and Angels of the Church of the Evernight Goddess together with Katarina Pelle. The Seven Orthodox Gods joined forces to fight against them, resulting in the destruction of Death in the early Fifth Epoch: 'His' death created the Berserk Sea that separated the Northern Continent and Southern Continent. The Balam Empire collapsed, creating a power vacuum in the Southern Continent. The Primordial Demoness was also heavily injured.

Gods no longer walked the land. The Orthodox Churches don't reveal 'Their' appearances for people to worship and use Sacred Emblems instead. The extraordinary power was concealed to the common people. The history about the previous epoch was ambiguous to the common people. They roughly knew the Solomon Empire, Tudor Empire and the Trunsoest Empire in chronological order. The Sanguines hid in all walks of life and had completely integrated into human society. The Resistance gradually appeared at the sea after the fall of Death. The Loen Kingdom occupied Sonia Island. The following secret organizations were formed: Numinous Episcopate, Theosophy Order, Life School of Thought, Rose School of Thought (under the Chained God). The Seven Orthodox Churches, along with the various nations, jointly pushed for a Cemetery Burial act.
Azik Eggers became the first Baron Lamud that ruled the Lamud Town.
Reinette Tinekerr was born.
The Highlands Kingdom and the Paz Kingdom were founded.
The Beria Family and the Andariel Family have gradually weakened since at least a thousand years ago, to the point of becoming vassals of the Nois Family in recent decades.
The Mother Tree of Desire suddenly appeared in this Epoch. Due to some accident, the Chained God was captured (and corrupted) by the Mother Tree of Desire.
Suah was born from a Sequence 1 characteristic of the Chained God. The Rose School of Thought indulgence faction started gaining momentum under the increasing influence of the Mother Tree of Desire.
The Fürth Firefish species stabilized after enduring corruption leaking from the sealed Fourth Epoch Trier.
Twenty-Year War between the Loen Kingdom and the Feysac Empire. Loen lost Sonia Island.
White Rose War. Loen defeated Intis and became powerful again. Audrey Hall ancestor obtained his first aristocratic title in this war.
Battle of the Violated Oath. Lenburg, Masin, and Segar gained independence from the Feynapotter Kingdom. Only the Church of the Earth Mother remained in the Feynapotter Kingdom.
Binsy Town was occupied by the Loen Kingdom. Later, due to changing the pronunciation and other factors, it gradually evolved into Bansy. The Aurora Order was formed.
Damir Harbor was occupied by the Loen Kingdom. The following secret organizations were formed: Iron and Blood Cross Order, Psychology Alchemists.
Roselle Gustav was born.
Huang Tao transmigrated as Roselle Gustav.
Bernadette Gustav was born.
Vermonda Sauron went mad and entered Fourth Epoch Trier, beginning the Sauron Family's bloodline curse.

Roselle Gustav made countless inventions based on his memory. The improved sailboats and the steam engine later cultivated the growing number of pirates and the birth of steamship. The God of Craftsmanship changed 'His' name to the God of Steam and Machinery to share in the progress of the enlightenment of civilization, and digested the remnant Sequence 1 potion inside 'Him'.
Roselle overthrew the Intis Kingdom, and through the acknowledgment of the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery, became the foremost Consul of the Intis Republic.
Roselle connected to Mr. Door.
Frunziar Edward stuck and became a character in the Groselle's Travels.
Roselle converted the Intis Republic into the Intis Empire and proclaimed himself 'Emperor Caesar'.

Roselle discovered a new safer sea route to the Southern Continent. This discovery jumpstarted the colonization of the Southern Continent, which was also known as the invasion of the Northern Continent. The Southern Continent was divided into East Balam and West Balam. East Balam: Loen and Feysac have been fighting over this colony for a long time. Eventually it became the Loen Kingdom's colony. West Balam: It is a complicated country that belonged to many factions. Some cities are managed by the Loen Kingdom, valleys belongs to Intis Republic. Some powerful independent states are secretly connected to the Numinous Episcopate. The Rose School of Thought and Feysac Empire also have a deep influence on West Balam. The crown of the Balam Empire was obtained by Augustus Family. The king of the Loen Kingdom then gave himself the title 'Emperor of the Balam Empire'.

Roselle Gustav became Sequence 0 Black Emperor of the Black Emperor Pathway somewhere around this time. Roselle was assassinated and died in a coup. Intis suffered several great shocks but ultimately managed to maintain a stable republican system, establishing itself as the Intis Republic again.
Old Neil was born.
The City of Silver's exploration team encountered Amon in a ruin. Amon secretly parasited on Uddel, a captain of the exploration team. Uddel was imprisoned since then.
The Rorsted Archipelago was colonized by the Loen Kingdom.
Emlyn White was born.
Dunn Smith was born.
Frank Lee was born.
Alger Wilson was born.
Danitz Dubois was born.
Anderson Hood was born.
Edwina Edwards was born.
Cattleya was born.
Frye was born.
Leonard Mitchell was born.
Benson Moretti was born.
The Backlund Metro was first constructed in the Loen Kingdom.
Daly Simone was born.
Fors Wall was born.
Sharron was born.
The Loen Kingdom enacted the 'Basic Education Law'.
Klein Moretti was born.
Xio Derecha was born.
Audrey Hall was born.
Melissa Moretti was born.
Selena Wood was born.
Dunn Smith became a Sleepless.
Danitz left his hometown and went to the seas.
Derrick Berg was born.
The Poor Law was established in the Loen Kingdom.
Konotop Sea battle. Loen and Feysac sea battle in East Balam’s Konotop.
Lumian Lee was born.
Xio's father, Mason Dere, was accused of participating in a revolt and executed. The Dere family was deprived of their aristocratic title and fiefdom.
Daly Simone became a Corpse Collector and was placed into a Nighthawks team.

Leonard Mitchell joined the Blackthorn Security Company and became a Sleepless. Ince Zangwill failed in his promotion. He defected from the church with Sealed Artifact 0-08. Fors Wall became an Apprentice.
Welch McGovern purchased the Antigonus Family's Notebook from Hanass Vincent. He asked Naya and the original Klein to interpret and record the content.
Susie was born.

events.subEra: Starting Point of Lord of Mysteries
events.description: Welch McGovern, Naya and the original Klein Moretti committed suicide. Zhou Mingrui transmigrated as Klein Moretti. The Curtain, a set of Sequence 9 to 1 characteristics of the Fool Pathway, was spat out of the Sefirah Castle to the Forsaken Land of the Gods. Kotar obtained the Curtain. The Tarot Club was founded.
Klein became a Beyonder of the Fool Pathway and officially joined the Nighthawks as an active member.
Mr. Harry (Darkwill's Owl) was born.
After an investigation of massacre of the Alfalfa case, the police put out an arrest warrant on Tris.

The number of death incidents in the Western District of Tingen City are five times the normal rate. Blackthorn Security Company investigated this issues. This is Klein's first group mission after becoming a Nighthawk.

True Creator's Spawn in Tingen City. Dunn Smith died protecting Tingen City. Klein Moretti's second death. Ince Zangwill obtained Saint Selena's Ashes and was promoted Sequence 4 Nightwatcher of the Darkness Pathway. Klein Moretti is resurrected. Klein sets his goal to take revenge on Ince Zangwill and Lanevus. Klein Moretti assumed the identity of Sherlock Moriarty and traveled to Backlund.
The Civil Servant Unified Examination Bill was officially passed by the House of Lords.
Great Smog of Backlund
Klein left Backlund and assumed the identity of Gehrman Sparrow. An old custom in Bansy Harbor was revived. Klein took over identity and authority of the Sea God Kalvetua.
The City of Silver arrived at the Afternoon Town. Klein returned to Backlund with identity of Dwayne Dantès.
The half of Zaratul sealed in Foggy Town is liberated by tricking Klein. Then Zaratul becomes reconnected and loses 'His' madness.
The Evernight Goddess obtained the Uniqueness of the Death Pathway.
Will Ceres was born.

World War began. The Feysac Empire attacked the capital of the Loen Kingdom, Backlund. On the same night, their Sonia Sea fleet attacked the Imperial Navy's main base in Oak Island. The Loen Kingdom declared the war on the Feysac Empire. The Feynapotter Kingdom and the Church of the Earth Mother invaded Lenburg.
Trissy got in contact with Mr. Door.

George Augustus III attempted to advance to the Black Emperor. The City of Silver obtained Frank's mushrooms from The Fool. George III's Apotheosis Ritual was foiled by Klein and co, resulting in 'His' death. This event escalated the war further with Intis joining the war. Amon brought Klein to the Forsaken Land of the Gods.

Jevington Augustus was crowned the King of the Loen Kingdom after the death of George III. During the war, the extraordinary power was exposed to the common people, especially the veterans who all witnessed it in the battlefield. Feysac Empire had taken three routes in invasion to the Loen Kingdom. The border along the Amantha mountain range in Winter County. Sonia Island, attacking the coastal harbors, and attempting a landing. Belltaine City in Midseashire. The Church of the Evernight Goddess successfully withstood the Feysac army in the Amantha Mountain range, and the Church of the Lord of Storms along with the navy withstood the Feysac and Feynapotter navy in the Sonia Sea. The Feysac Empire successfully defeated the Midseashire army and invaded Belltaine City and occupied Constant City. They then invaded Loen all the way to Backlund and met with the Intis army.
In the Forsaken Land of the Gods, Klein discovered the Moon City.
True Creator arrived and planted a corruptive seed in Klein's body that forced him to open the door that leads to Sasrir's resting place in the Giant King's Court.

The Resistance take over the government Rorsted Archipelago. The Battle of Gods started. The Evernight Goddess fought against the God of Combat and the Earth Mother in Backlund. The God of Knowledge and Wisdom fought against the Eternal Blazing Sun in the capital of Lenburg. The Lord of Storms fought against the God of Steam and Machinery in Bayam. Klein, Colin Iliad, Lovia, and Derrick Berg enter the Giant King's Court and fought against Sasrir Evil Spirit. Amon took the opportunity to steal the First Blasphemy Slate from them, which resulted in 'Him' being pursued by the True Creator. The gate of Giant King's Court was pushed open. The Forsaken Land of the Gods finally connected to the real world.
During the World War, Hugues Artois deserted his troops. Albert Goncourt led the rebellion known as the Carbonari, uprising, opposing the government's militants in Trier.

World War ended. The God of Combat was backstabbed by the Earth Mother and fell. The Evernight Goddess obtained the Twilight Giant Uniqueness. The Evernight Goddess gave 'Her' part of the Authority of the Moon (the Moon Uniqueness) to Lilith. 'She' removed 'Her' ‘Lady of Crimson’ title. The Sacred Emblem of the Church of the Evernight Goddess changed from the crimson moon to that of stars.

Adam promoted to Sequence 0 Visionary of the Visionary Pathway. The Church of the God of Steam and Machinery lost their standing in the Loen Kingdom. They had to transfer all their Grade 2 and above Sealed Artifacts out of Loen back to the Intis Republic. The intrusion of the Outer Deities into the world deepened.

Klein left the Forsaken Land of the Gods and promoted to Sequence 2 Miracle Invoker, becoming an Angel. 'He' assumed the identity of the wandering magician Merlin Hermes. Larrion ran away from the Church of the God of Combat together with the Sealed Artifact 0-02. 'He' destroyed the articles containing information about all Sealed Artifacts. Arianna went after 'Him' to Belltaine City.
The City of Silver and the Moon City left the Forsaken Land of the Gods. With the help of Alger and Danitz, they settle the new home in Rorsted Archipelago, near Bayam.
Bernadette Gustav found Roselle's primitive island. She met and sealed Roselle using a symbol from Pale Death and help from Mr. Fool.
The True Creator sealed off the gate of the Forsaken Land of the Gods.
Klein established 'His' marionette town Utopia. Around this time, the Church of the Fool was founded in Bayam.

Zaratul cooperated with Adam and successfully raided Utopia. Klein was captured inside the Corpse Cathedral by Adam. Verdu Garcia was tricked by Medici and Amon into holding a ritual to release Mr. Door. Mr. Door returned from 'His' banishment. Due to 'Her' contamination, the Mother Goddess of Depravity also tried to breach the barrier and enter Earth. Mr. Door willingly gave up 'His' life to Amon to stop the Mother Goddess of Depravity. Amon stole Mr. Door place in 'His' apotheosis ritual, and became 'Mr. Error', the God of both the Error and Door pathways. Adam arrived in the Forsaken Land of the Gods to confront the True Creator. Adam used Arrodes to trigger the Chaos Sea, then 'He' used the Second Blasphemy Slate to form a connection with the triggered area of the Chaos Sea. 'He' then stepped forward into the shadow curtain to confront the True Creator.
Klein's Apotheosis Ritual: The Fool's Gambit

The Fool Klein, now half a Lord of Mysteries, released all souls from their cocoons in the Sefirah Castle. They transmigrated into the bodies of those who had just died in the real world. Then 'He' entered a state of slumber.
The God of Knowledge and Wisdom has prophesied that The Apocalypse will happen in the year 1368 of the Fifth Epoch.

Xio Derecha once claimed that the day a Beyonder could live a carefree life might only be attainable at the end of the Fifth Epoch and the beginning of the Sixth Epoch, if there is even a Sixth Epoch at all.
Aurore Lee moved to Cordu Village.
Aurore went on a journey. She brought back a homeless child and named him Lumian Lee.
Clémence Athana was sealed, becoming Sealed Artifact 1-147.
Aurore purchased the Soul Summoning spell from the April Fool's Gathering. This led to the manifestation of her split personality, Roche Louise Sanson.
Aurore begin propagating the faith of Inevitability in Cordu Village.

Aurore covertly approached Guillaume Bénet and advised him to consider converting his faith to embrace Inevitability. The Cordu villagers began discussing horoscopes, believing that it would bring them glory and alter their destinies.
Louis Lund found Madame Pualis's abnormality and reported it to Guillaume Bénet.
Lumian discovered Louis's affairs and threatened him.
Ava, Reimund, Naroka and others were murdered. Lumian tries to get revenge on Pons Bénet, but failed. He realized that Aurore may be a high-ranking member on Guillaume's faction.
Aurore dragged Pualis, while Guillaume suddenly launched an attack on the Administrator's Castle with a group of people. Pualis and her people withdraws from Cordu Village.
The grand sacrificial ritual was held in the Cordu Village, Intis Republic, but it was unsuccessful. The entire village had been destroyed with only six villagers had survived.
Lumian Lee, using the pseudonym Ciel, arrived in Trier.
Lumian found Guillaume Bénet.

The Hostel ritual briefly opened the seal of Fourth Epoch Trier. Beyonders of the Hermit and Paragon Pathways experienced the same wilderness dream. Vermonda Sauron died in Fourth Epoch Trier, thereby ending the Sauron Family's bloodline curse which lasted 200 years. After 2,081 years, Medici once again ascended to the title of King of Angels.
Lumian left Trier and assumed the identity of Louis Berry. He disembark in Port Farim, then arrived in Port Santa. Port Santa Sea Prayer Ritual began.
Lumian arrived at West Balam.
The Tizamo Town Dream Festival began. Reinette Tinekerr recovered 'Her' heart. A Meteor fell in Tizamo Town and kill those who are dead within the Dream Festival.
Lumian returned to Trier to help Franca Roland deal with Mirror People case.
With an invitation of the Knight of Swords, Lumian went to the Raklev City to provide assistance, and then entered the Underworld. Lumian obtained a half-body of Abscessed Hand in the Underworld.
In order to help Franca Roland digest the potion, they went to Banamo Port in the Fog Sea to ambush Howl Constantine.
Lumian went to Lenburg alone to find Morora. Immediately after arriving in Azshara, he was arrested and sent directly to Morora.

Main article: Project Vortex. Roselle forcibly reviving. The Uncertain Mist is heavily injured by Roselle and has to sleep for sixty years to recover. Roselle perished. He can only be resurrected after a hundred years. Tirié was born.
Main article: The Fool's Dream. The Fool achieves an initial state of awakening.

Led by The Fool, the Tarot Club launches the operation of Hunting Hidden Sage. The Hidden Sage is killed by The Fool and the God of Steam and Machinery. The Moses Ascetic Order is destroyed after being attacked by the Tarot Club, the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery, and the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
